formatHint.mp3: Plays everywhere, with tags and cover art.
formatHint.m4a: AAC, or lossless ALAC, with tags and cover art. Suits Apple devices and iTunes.
formatHint.opus: YouTube's own audio stream, copied without re-encoding: the best quality for its size. Some older players cannot play it.
formatHint.ogg: Ogg Vorbis, an open format for players and games that prefer it. No cover art.
formatHint.flac: Lossless, with tags and cover art. It cannot add quality beyond YouTube's source, but suits lossless-only libraries.
formatHint.wav: Uncompressed PCM for audio editing. About 10 MB per minute, with minimal tags and no cover art.
formatHint.mp4: H.264 + AAC that plays on any device.
formatHint.mkv: Keeps YouTube's original video and audio without re-encoding, fast even at 4K. Some TVs and built-in players cannot play it.
formatHint.mov: H.264 + AAC for Apple devices and video editors.
formatHint.webm: VP9 + Opus for the web, usually without re-encoding.
formatHint.avi: MPEG-4 (Xvid) + MP3 for older players. The video is always re-encoded.
formatHint.flv: H.264 + AAC in a Flash video file, for older software that requires it.
